items.title: File Einspruch against the interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026 (posting day). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter sent by ordinary post from a German tax office is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period of § 355 Abs. 1 AO starts the day after deemed delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO), i.e. from 23.11.2026, and ends one month later on the same-numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in NW (not a weekend or holiday), so no further shift applies.
